== Description ==

Tournament hall at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025, with [[Nick Swedal]] (left, grey T-shirt), [[Steve Harpster]] (center, grey T-shirt and silver hair), and [[Ken Cross]] (right, grey and black Columbia fleece) at the foreground table; other players unlabeled.
